transcript_rule: VEP flag_pick: MANE Select > MANE Plus Clinical > canonical > APPRIS > TSL > biotype > CCDS > consequence rank > transcript length. On the chosen transcript the most severe SO term is reported.

clinvar.access: tabix query of each variant position, allele matched on REF and ALT
clinvar.classification_field: CLNSIG (aggregate germline classification); conflicts in CLNSIGCONF

gnomad.allele_frequency: joint AC/AN (exomes + genomes). Exome-only and genome-only AF are stored separately.
gnomad.faf95: filtering allele frequency, 95% confidence, population maximum
